name: mail-send
description: The subject method sends mail: through a mail library (Spring's JavaMailSender or MailSender, Jakarta Mail's Transport, Apache Commons Email, Simple Java Mail, Quarkus's or Micronaut's mailer), whose server comes from the config (spring.mail.host) or a mail-host fact, or through a mail provider's SDK (SendGrid, Amazon SES, Mailgun), which names the provider (ADR 0076).

template.description: The binary name of the type whose method sends, such as org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSender.

method.description: The name of the method called, such as send.

provider.description: The mail provider an SDK sends through, such as SendGrid, Amazon SES or Mailgun; absent for a mail library.

name: mail-host
description: The subject method sets the mail server's host as a constant, such as smtp.example.com: through JavaMailSenderImpl.setHost, Apache Commons Email's setHostName or Simple Java Mail's MailerBuilder.withSMTPServer (ADR 0076).

template.description: The binary name of the type whose method sets the host, such as org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSenderImpl.

method.description: The name of the method called, such as setHost.
